reason: A user-interface plugin that displays session cost and balance statistics below the composer, with expandable usage details, configurable presentation settings, currency conversion options, and persistent local configuration.

summaries.zh: 在输入框下方显示会话余额、花费及缓存命中等统计信息，并提供可配置的显示设置与一键还原功能。
summaries.en: Displays session balance, cost, and cache-hit statistics below the composer with configurable presentation settings and a one-click reset.

capabilities: Displays session cost, balance, token, cache-hit, and usage statistics
Provides configurable display settings and one-click reset
Persists plugin configuration in a local DSH profile file
